summary: Independent verification of GHID_WINDOWS.md + helper scripts on Linux (PowerShell-specific parts not executable). The provided pytest suite (/app/desktop/tests/test_windows_guide_flow.py) ran clean: 3 passed in 5.99s via `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider` from /app/desktop. In addition, re-ran the LOCAL-mode flow end-to-end by hand against port 8181 and validated the ONLINE-mode CLI pieces + sync endpoint behavior on ports 8182/8183.

verifications.name: pytest test_windows_guide_flow.py
verifications.result: PASS 3/3 (local flow, online flow, reset_admin_password); junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration12_guide.xml

verifications.name: Section 7 citizen flow (LOCAL, --portal-only --port 8181)
verifications.result: PASS: POST /api/public/account/register => 200; anonymous POST /api/public/cerere => 401 (CIMITIR_PORTAL_REQUIRE_ACCOUNT=1 default confirmed in backend/citizen_api.py:43); logged-in POST with PDF => 200 documente==1; file persisted at /tmp/w1/media/cerere/*.pdf; after cimitir_requests.approve_cerere(actor='MAIN') -> account cereri status='validat' and public /api/public/cerere/<cod>.status='validat'

verifications.name: Admin main_only guard
verifications.result: PASS: POST /admin/ui/cerere/<id>/status without session => 401; with admin session => 303 to login/schimba-parola (admin cannot alter cerere status from web)

verifications.name: Section 5 file paths
verifications.result: PASS: /tmp/w1/cimitir.db, /tmp/w1/.jwt_secret (0600), /tmp/w1/logs/portal.log, /tmp/w1/media/cerere/ all exist as the guide claims

verifications.name: Section 3 reset_admin_password script (covered by pytest #3)
verifications.result: PASS: --list prints username/role/active without password hashes or secrets; weak password rejected (exit 2); unknown user without --create-admin (exit 3); --create-admin succeeds; after reset, POST /admin/access/login with admin123 does NOT return 303, new password returns 303 (no /schimba-parola in Location). New password never echoed in stdout/stderr.

verifications.name: Section 6 ONLINE CLI pieces
verifications.result: PASS: issue_sync_key.py prints key as last stdout line starting with 'cimitir.'; configure_main_sync.py --test exits 0 (per pytest); non-localhost http:// URL refused with exit code 2 and clear Romanian error; GET /api/sync/ping on CIMITIR_MODE=online server without X-Sync-Key => 401; same path on local-mode server => 404 (sync_api not mounted)

verifications.name: Section 4 env-file order & defaults
verifications.result: PASS: shared/cimitir_config.env_files() order is [CIMITIR_ENV_FILE, <repo>/.env, <repo>/backend/.env]; load_env() does `if key not in os.environ` so pre-set process env wins (matches guide). backend/citizen_api.py:43 default CIMITIR_PORTAL_REQUIRE_ACCOUNT fallback is '1'. backend/server.py:66 CIMITIR_SEED_DEMO gate uses '1' as claimed.

verifications.name: No secret leakage
verifications.result: PASS: `grep -nE '(admin123|user123|JWT_SECRET=[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|cimitir\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})' GHID_WINDOWS.md config/cimitir-online-server.env.example` => zero matches. The example file instructs the user to run `python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"` without providing a placeholder value.

verifications.name: Desktop menu labels referenced by guide
verifications.result: PASS: '📥 Cereri online' and '☁ Sincronizare cloud' present in /app/desktop/ui_mainwindow.py; 'Adresă server:' and 'Cheie sincronizare:' present in /app/desktop/cloud_sync_window.py:57-58; '✅ Validează → adaugă în concesionar' present in /app/desktop/cereri_online_window.py:283

critical_code_review_comments: configure_main_sync.py never prints the --key value (verified: `key not in done.stdout + done.stderr` assertion in pytest); good hygiene for secret handling.

reset_admin_password.py uses getpass for interactive mode and allows automation via --password-env; the password is validated with auth.validate_new_password before being applied and is never echoed. Confirmed empirically.

shared/cimitir_config.load_env() correctly honours existing process env (`if item[0] not in os.environ`), which matches the guide's claim about PowerShell-set variables taking precedence over .env files.
backend/citizen_api.py require_account() default is '1' only if the DB setting is absent/empty — matches guide statement that account is required by default and can be toggled from /admin/setari.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all claims from the guide verified against the code and against a live portal on 127.0.0.1:8181/8182/8183)

test_credentials: admin / admin123 default from shared/cimitir_auth.py DEFAULT_USERS (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md); forced password change at first login. Guide intentionally does not print defaults.
seed_data_creation: All temp DBs under /tmp/w1, /tmp/w2s2, /tmp/wlocal; cleaned up at end. No modifications to /app/shared_data, /app/backend/data, or any committed file.
